title: 第13章 胜利与招待第3章 特性 终焉蜕变
content_zh:
“卧槽！！！”
全场观众都震惊了。
这到底是怎么回事，他怎么流了那么多血还能站起来？！他是人是鬼？
此时此刻，私人vip席位上。
女人的目光带着十分炽烈的好奇心，嘴角勾笑看着赛场：
“有意思，真是有意思。”
刘坤也在一旁附和：
“的确，这样的少年也是令我生平仅见，受了这么严重的伤都还能站起来，意志力、实力同样超乎预料。”
在他看来，能脸接这么多拳而不死，抗击打能力绝对排得上号，甚至同境无出其右，难怪少年没有被吓退。
可从表现来看，他几乎不会实战，也因此被压制着打。
不过若好好培养这少年，斗拳场将来未必不会多出一名新星。
“受伤？不，他从一开始就没受伤。”
女人的话却是让刘坤一愣。
但刘坤却没有任何提出质疑的念头。
毕竟身旁的这位，不仅仅是野望斗拳场背后的美女老板，更是一名四境强者！
是那个说出名字就能让人闻风丧胆的地下女王——
虞吟霜。
她得出的推断，自是可信。
此刻，就见虞吟霜两条黑丝美腿换位交叠，笑吟吟道：
“那些血不过是血浆包道具罢了，血液新不新鲜，我隔老远就能闻出来，至于方才少年面骨断折、凹陷时的场面，则像是某种特殊的法门，迷惑性很强。”

她从容给出分析：
“毕竟骨骼碎裂可不会好得那么快，你看他面具下的轮廓，压根就不像受伤的样子。”
闻言，刘坤都愣了。
也就是说这少年实力很强，一直都在扮猪吃老虎？可他搞这些弄虚作假的血浆干什么？
似乎是读懂了刘坤的困惑，虞吟霜继续道：
“这就是他有意思的地方了，分明实力远强于对手，还要搞出这么一出大戏表演给观众看......呵呵，想我野望斗拳场几乎从不办假赛，却让这小子靠着弄虚作假，把人气提升到了顶峰。”
后面这半句倒不假。
抛开其他的不谈，王生这一顿操作几乎成为了有史以来最具看点的比赛。
血腥屠戮的虐杀局并不是没有过，可被虐杀的人反客为主，突然站起来攻守易型，那可是没见过啊。
刘坤也理解了其中门道：
“他是想引起我们的重视，以此谋取更大利益？”
content_en:
"Fuck!!!"
The entire audience was shocked.
What was going on? How could he still stand up after bleeding so much? ! Is he a human or a ghost?
At this moment, in a private VIP seat.
The woman's eyes were filled with intense curiosity, and she looked at the arena with a smile on her face:
"Interesting, really interesting."
Liu Kun also echoed:
"Indeed, I have never seen such a young man. He was able to stand up even after suffering such a serious injury. His willpower and strength are also beyond expectations."
In his opinion, being able to take so many punches in the face without dying, his ability to withstand blows is definitely ranked high, even unrivaled in the same situation. No wonder the young man was not scared away.
But judging from his performance, he hardly knew how to fight in actual combat, so he was suppressed and beaten.
However, if this young man is properly trained, there may not be a new star in the boxing ring in the future.
"Injured? No, he wasn't injured in the first place."
The woman's words made Liu Kun stunned.
But Liu Kun had no idea of ​​questioning.
After all, the person next to me is not only the beautiful boss behind the Ambition Dou Boxing Arena, but also a strong person in the Four Realms!
She is the underground queen whose name can make people fearful——
Yu Yinshuang.
The inference she drew was certainly believable.
At this moment, I saw Yu Yinshuang's two beautiful black stocking legs changing positions and overlapping each other, and said with a smile:
"That blood is nothing more than plasma pack props. I can smell it from a long distance if the blood is fresh or not. As for the scene when the young man's facial bones were broken and dented, it was like some kind of special method, which is very confusing."
She calmly gave her analysis:
"After all, broken bones don't heal that quickly. If you look at the outline under his mask, it doesn't look like he was injured at all."
Hearing this, Liu Kun was stunned.
In other words, this young man is very powerful and has been pretending to be a pig and eating the tiger? But what is he doing with these fake plasmas?
Seemingly understanding Liu Kun's confusion, Yu Yinshuang continued:
"This is what's interesting about him. He is clearly far stronger than his opponent, yet he still puts on such a big show for the audience... Haha, I think our Ambition Dou Boxing Arena almost never holds fake matches, but this kid has raised his popularity to the top by relying on fraud."
The last half of the sentence is true.
Putting aside everything else, Wang Sheng's operation has almost become the most interesting game in history.
There have been bloody massacres, but it has never been seen before that the people who were killed suddenly turned around and suddenly stood up to attack and defend.
Liu Kun also understood the secret:
"Is he trying to attract our attention to seek greater benefits?"
